messages:
maria-fin: Quick alert — discovered ~$47,200 mismatch in March billing export: Dedicated usage appears on Hosted lines for two customers. Need guidance for month-end JE and deferral.

james-rev: Can you share which customers and a sample of the export rows?

maria-fin: AcmeCorp (12345) and NimbusAI (67890). Sample rows: invoice INV-2026-0345 shows hosted.generations, amount 30,200 but pool_id blank; should map to POOL-DC-1. INV-2026-0370 has 17,000 similarly.

billing-bot: Export uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/monthly/2026-03/export_1768001234.csv

sara-inv: Proposed provisional JE: DR Unbilled Receivables $47,200 / CR Revenue $47,200 to reverse hosted revenue until re-bill. Will attach invoice refs and narrative.

aaron-sales: AcmeCorp moved to Dedicated Feb 15 per SOW — agree they shouldn't be on hosted rates. We discussed a customer credit.

eng-billing: Ack. Reproducer found parser edge-case when migration_flag is set; pool_id gets dropped for legacy sku lines. We'll patch parser and re-run export. ETA EOD tomorrow. Will post corrected path.

cody-cfo: Approve provisional accrual and reversal pending final reprocessed export and tie-out. Add note in close checklist about root cause and remediation.

sara-inv: I'll file the JE as PENDING_REPROCESS and include amortization plan for any deferred revenue. If reprocess changes numbers, we'll update the JE before final close.

james-rev: I'll reconcile once eng posts the new export and circulate the worksheet. Capture this as a control defect for auditors. Thanks team.
